India asks US to reconsider proposed tariffs over labor probe

India has formally requested the United States to withdraw proposed tariffs on its imports, citing a lack of adequate evidence for the US claims of forced labor. India's submission argues that the current trade framework does not unfairly distort trade. The proposed tariffs, which could affect up to 60 countries, are part of a US investigation into labor practices.
